records.text: Jonathan Barcelo served in the U.S. Marine Corps from about 2013 to 2017, provided embassy security, and worked as a helicopter technician for an attack squadron.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And Jonathan Marcello is an interesting character because of his background. Of course, he's a Marine in the Marine Corps from 2013 at least until up until 2017. ... He was providing security to the Marine Corps to their various embassies throughout the world. I think you're supposed to do three embassies or securing like state secrets or something, particularly that can only find that he was stationed in Chile. ... He also worked as a helicopter technician for an attack squadron.

verification.notes: Jonathan Barcelo's public professional profile lists Marine embassy-security service from 2013 to 2017 and earlier AH-1W/UH-1N avionics work with a light attack helicopter squadron. ASU also lists him as a former undergraduate research assistant. The service details are primarily self-reported, so confidence is medium.

records.text: Jonathan Barcelo ran a private-investigation firm from 2017 to 2022, graduated from Arizona State University in forensic psychology, and then took development and donor-operations jobs at Turning Point USA.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He also worked as a helicopter technician for an attack squadron. Then from 2017 to 2022, he worked as a private investigator, ran a private investigative firm. ... And during that time, he graduates from ASU, all the best people do, with a major in forensic psychology. ... And then suddenly he gets a job working in donations as a development operations administrator at Turning Point USA. ... And then it becomes a donor's operations manager.

verification.notes: Barcelo's public profile supports private-investigator/security work from 2017 to 2022, an ASU forensic-psychology degree, and a later Turning Point USA donor-operations role. It describes him as a private investigator and field-operations director but does not independently establish that he owned or ran the firm, so that portion remains unconfirmed.
